cd /work && python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.array(Image.open('observations/obs_0096.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
r,g,b=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
def bb(m,n):
    ys,xs=np.where(m)
    if len(xs): print(n,'u',xs.min(),xs.max(),'v',ys.min(),ys.max(),'n',len(xs)); return (xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max())
    print(n,'none')
bb((b>r+40)&(b>150),'vase')
bb((r>120)&(r<190)&(g>55)&(g<115)&(b<70)&(np.arange(512)[None,:]>230),'chairbrown')
bb((abs(r-g)<12)&(abs(g-b)<16)&(r>60)&(r<130),'darkgray_legs')
bb((r>150)&(g>130)&(b<130)&(g<r)&(r-b>50)&(np.arange(512)[None,:]>350),'lampshade')
print('--- chair/stool column bottoms (brown)')
m=(r>120)&(r<190)&(g>55)&(g<115)&(b<70)
for u in range(255,345,8):
    rr=np.where(m[:,u])[0]
    if len(rr): print('u',u,'vtop',rr.min(),'vbot',rr.max())
print('--- leg bottoms (dark gray) per column')
lm=(abs(r-g)<12)&(abs(g-b)<16)&(r>60)&(r<130)
for u in range(265,340,6):
    rr=np.where(lm[:,u])[0]
    if len(rr): print('u',u,'vbot',rr.max())
print('--- lamp base')
lb=(abs(r-g)<14)&(abs(g-b)<18)&(r>60)&(r<140)
sub=np.zeros_like(r,dtype=bool); sub[:,370:430]=True
bb(lb&sub,'lampbase')
" 2>/dev/null
